Requires Level 5 
 Théodred equips his royal cloak 
 Modifier Type: Leadership 
 Grants +20% to armour and +10% to attack damage and health regeneration 
 for Théoden, Éomer, and Éowyn 
 Nearby units gain +33% damage 
Passive ability

Теодену, Еомеру й Еовін
